question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.
sql:
-- Final query with proper date formatting
WITH customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(MIN(txn_date) AS DATE) as min_date,
        CAST(MAX(txn_date) AS DATE) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
daily_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        ds.date_val
    FROM customer_date_range cdr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(cdr.min_date, cdr.max_date, INTERVAL '1 day') AS ds(date_val)
),
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) as net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
daily_balances_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        dd.customer_id,
        dd.date_val,
        COALESCE(dc.net_change, 0) as daily_change
    FROM daily_dates dd
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc 
        ON dd.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND dd.date_val = dc.txn_date
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_val,
        daily_change,
        SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date_val) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_balances_raw
),
daily_balances_capped AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_val,
        GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(date_trunc('month', date_val) AS DATE) as month_start,
        MAX(balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances_capped
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', date_val) AS DATE)
)
SELECT month_start, SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start
